stem: The geometric mean of the two numbers 4 and 16 is:

per_option_rationale.rationale: 10 is the arithmetic mean (4+16)/2 = 10; a student uses the wrong average formula and computes AM instead of GM.
6.4 is the harmonic mean 2/(1/4 + 1/16) = 2/(4/16 + 1/16) = 2/(5/16) = 32/5 = 6.4; a student uses HM formula instead of GM formula.
64 is the product 4*16 = 64 without taking the square root; a student applies GM = a*b forgetting the nth root step.

explanation: For two numbers a and b, the geometric mean is sqrt(a * b). Here GM = sqrt(4 * 16) = sqrt(64) = 8.

explanation_sections.punchline: GM is the square root of the product, not the average of the two numbers.
explanation_sections.approach: Identify the model: GM of n values = (product of all values)^(1/n). For n=2: GM = sqrt(a*b). Map givens a=4, b=16. Compute: 4*16=64, sqrt(64)=8.
explanation_sections.lesson: GM of two numbers a and b equals sqrt(a*b). For n numbers it is the nth root of their product.
explanation_sections.timing: Under 30 seconds. Direct single-formula application. Eliminate 64 immediately (product without root) and 10 (arithmetic mean).
